text:
maya: Heads-up — ran into a weird failure using the JS SDK in Next.js Edge middleware. Local dev/sandbox works but preview/prod edge throws: "TypeError: Request.prototype.clone is not a function" and TS griping about Response types. Anyone seen this? :thinking_face:
sam: Yup. Ran into something similar last week. It's usually the package entrypoint that gets bundled for edge by SWC. Mixing CJS default exports with ESM edge entrypoints causes the runtime to pull in a node-y shim.
sam: Workaround I used: import the edge-specific build directly. e.g.
```js
import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference/edge.mjs'
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
```
sam: That avoided the CJS surface and fixed the clone/type issues for me.
eli: Another gotcha: our auth refresh code relied on setTimeout + AbortController patterns that don't exist in the Edge runtime (no timers). That causes unhandled promise hangs. Replaced timeouts with a signal-based fallback and short-circuit checks.
eli: Example fix (very small):
```js
// avoid setTimeout in edge middleware
function fetchWithTimeout(resource, opts) {
  // prefer AbortController.signal.timeout if available or inline deadline check
  return fetch(resource, opts)
}
```
maya: Thanks — that explains why my repro only shows up in Vercel preview, not local next dev. I tried a direct import hack and it fixed runtime, but TS still complains in the middleware file: "Cannot find name 'Request'". I think Next's middleware TS config doesn't include the right libs.
eli: Right — two paths here: 1) teach SDK types to be Web/Edge-only (declare global fetch/Request types) or 2) doc the tsconfig tweak (add "lib": ["esnext","dom"] for middleware tsconfig). I prefer SDK shipping edge-types so users don't have to tweak.
maya: I can paste a tiny repro. Here's my middleware:
```js
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference/edge.mjs'

export async function middleware(req) {
  const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
  const res = await client.generate({ prompt: 'hi' })
  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true })
}
```
maya: In prod this errors with clone/typing explosion.
jorge: Thanks for the repro, @maya. Filing an SDK issue now. Short-term we can add an explicit export in package.json: `{ \"exports\": { \"./edge\": \"./dist/edge.mjs\" } }` and a dedicated types file `edge.d.ts` that references web libs only.
jorge: We'll also audit auth refresh to remove reliance on timers so it behaves in service worker/edge contexts.
dev-bot: deploy-preview: Preview deployment created for branch edge-sdk-fix — https://vercel.com/rw/preview/edge-sdk-fix (should show the error / then the fix once landed) :rocket:
sam: Pro tip — Next dev server masks some edge-only failures. Reproduce reliably with `vercel dev --edge` or deploy a preview (the runtime is closer to prod).
eli: One more TS note: SDK types should avoid node types like Buffer/NodeJS.Timer in public surface. That was tripping a few users. We should split types: index.d.ts (node-friendly) and edge.d.ts (web-friendly).
jorge: Plan: small patch release with 4 items — 1) add /edge export + edge.mjs build, 2) publish edge.d.ts types, 3) replace timer-based auth retry with edge-safe pattern, 4) add a Next.js edge sample app to examples/ and docs. Target: EOD Friday for a patch.
maya: Awesome — I'll attach logs and the minimal sample app in the new issue. Happy to test previews. :thumbsup:
